name: Decision Trace Reconstructor
description: Post-hoc reconstruction of multi-step decision chains from fragmentary evidence, with decision-event schema mapping and authorization-envelope substitution for ML-opaque steps. Reference implementation of the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM) property-level reconstructability assessment.

releaseNotes: Version 0.2.0 separates structural coverage from typed decision evidence and adds offline replication tooling. Published 11 October 2026; software DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23297502. See docs/releases/0.2.0.md and CHANGELOG.md. Frozen study data require a separate deposit.
